subject: Error: package ‘iplots’ could not be loaded

messages.author: 67bfc13dc675fca5
messages.subject: Error: package ‘iplots’ could not be loaded
parts:
Have R 2.14 installed in a computer, with WinXP, 32 bit, in which I have no administrator privileges, so I cannot run the Deducer installer. Installed the required packages. When loading the JGR package, I get the following error messages

 

Loading required package: rJava

Loading required package: JavaGD

Loading required package: iplots

Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'iplots', details:

  call: .jinit()

  error: cannot obtain Class.getSimpleName method ID

Error: package ‘iplots’ could not be loaded

 

Since iplots cannot be loaded, nothing is loaded and the JGR interface is not opened.

 

Any solution for this? Any other alternative to load the Deducer interface? It is really cool and helpful!

 

Any help will be really appreciated

Thanks

 

Jose

messages.subject: Re: Error: package ‘iplots’ could not be loaded
parts:
Try:

1. open Rgui.exe
2. type:
library(JGR)
JGR()

if this doesn't work, let me know what the output of the following is...
library(JGR)
.libPaths()
sessionInfo()

messages.author: 67bfc13dc675fca5
messages.subject: Re: Error: package ‘iplots’ could not be loaded
parts:
Forgot to mention that the iplots library is in the list of the libraries and I successfully got it updated. I have installed it in another computer in which I have full privileges and I could load both JGR and iplots, the same versions I have in this first computer where I don't have administrator privileges. That't why I had to install R not in the default "C:\Program files" but in "\\\\jmcnas02/home".
It may be a problem with the Java version I have in this computer but I can't install anything in "C:\Program files", thus, I cannot do any Java updates! I have j2re1.4.2_06 in this computer and jre6 in the effective computer.

Jose
